records.context: Every vendor CLI executes without tools inside spaCR (2026-11-18), so the note is the same for every provider: answer in text, and when something has to be executed, give the user the exact command for their own terminal. This function only returns the note; the caller appends it to the system prompt.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.prompts.tool_approval_note#1
records.source: Every vendor CLI runs without tools inside spaCR (2026-11-18), so the note is the same for every provider: answer in text, and when something has to be run, give the user the exact command for their own terminal. This function only returns the note; the caller appends it to the system prompt.
records.translation: Hvert skipanalínutól söluaðila keyrir án verkfæra innan spaCR (2026-11-18), svo athugasemdin er sú sama fyrir alla veitendur: svara í texta og, þegar eitthvað þarf að keyra, gefa notandanum nákvæma skipun fyrir hans eigin útstöð. Þetta fall skilar aðeins athugasemdinni; kallandinn bætir henni við kerfiskvaðninguna.
